meta.title: Buyer submits the award proposal into an approval workflow

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded proposal where the buyer can submit it for approval.

args.goal: on the award proposal screen, click the top-right Submit Proposal, select the appropriate configured approval workflow, review the proposal details including line items, values and type, add closing remarks if needed, scroll to verify the full approval chain, click the bottom-right Submit Proposal, and stop on the Approval Screen showing the generated note for approval, event overview, allocation details and full approval chain

steps.note: Perform the workflow selection, proposal review, approval-chain verification and final submission in the buyer session.
Confirm the buyer was taken to the Approval Screen after submission.
Confirm the generated approval note is shown on the resulting approval screen.
Confirm allocation details are present in the submitted approval view.
